protocol: Same protocol as labels-heldout.json. Fresh set: labelled by hand from the prepared text and frozen (checksum in fresh/FROZEN.txt) before any extractor (old or new) was run on these files. decision: the notes record that the group decided, agreed, approved or resolved something, or reached consensus. open question: a question about what to do that the notes leave unresolved. proposal: a suggestion put to the group that is not recorded as decided. Questions answered in the notes are not labelled. ambiguous: true marks borderline sentences (action items, individual opinions, deferrals, agenda boilerplate, tentative plans); a finding that matches one is not scored. A sentence repeated in a file is labelled once.

Ultimately, a good starter issue was found in creating a new Polonius "hybrid" variant, bridging the location insensitive and complete analyses: a realistic way for rustc to use Polonius.
The major next steps we decided on were:
[Matthew] will write mentoring instructions for the hybrid algorithm task.
[Niko] and [Albin] will prepare the follow-up walkthrough of Polonius (the specific time, and contents).
[Niko] will review the subset relation PR.
The goal would be to find crates, and functions, which would be representative along different dimensions, and incorporate their facts files in the Polonius repo to be used for tests and benchmarks.

A useful task was mentioned for the near future: going through the Polonius failures in rustc's test suite (using the `--compare-mode polonius` test mode), categorizing the failures, and possibly making the tests pass, by `--bless`ing the expected polonius test output files.
[Albin] will continue on the liveness fact generation in rustc.
[Rémy] will continue work on the `Hybrid` variant optimization.
[@lokalmatador] will familiarize with the steps [Niko] wrote, with available help from the rest of the WG.
